teaser: A reply to Nadzeya Stalbouskaya: removing servers simplifies only if you move to real commodities, so map it and ask who would certify it.
core_idea: Removing your own servers and databases can outsource complexity rather than remove it, so the move must be a conscious, mapped decision: moving a component to a genuine commodity such as passkeys or object storage simplifies, while a young startup's service may only look like a commodity, and the test is whether anyone would certify, insure or guarantee what you now depend on.
